name: Calendar
description: Show one to seven days of live events, including all-day events and highlighted moments.

startDate.description: First day shown. When absent, a seven-day calendar starts on the Monday of the current local week, and a shorter one starts today.

days.description: Number of days shown, one column each; 7 when absent.

visibleHours.description: The hours that fill the view, such as {"start": 9, "end": 18} for 9 AM to 6 PM. When absent, hours have their usual height.

end.description: Hour the view ends at; later than start.

events.description: Events in the calendar, keyed by a push ID or a chosen string. The key is never displayed.

detail.description: One line shown under the title, such as a place or a note.

start.description: Start, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM local time, or YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event.

end.description: End, in the same form as start. A timed event ends on the day it starts. An all-day event's end date is the day after its last day.

allDay.description: True for an all-day event; false when absent.

attendees.description: Names of the people attending, in display order.

highlight.description: True to make the event stand out, as for one the agent has just added. An agent clears it by setting it to false or removing it.
